independence_proof: Verbatim from the board: both rows carry depends_on null/[] - no edge either way. Disjoint file sets, verified on disk at HEAD 6ea9495: RELEASE-001 owns .github/workflows/ci.yml (lines 270/353) + e2e-full-battery.sh (the bcli() wrapper at 362-364); DF-BUNKER-43 owns the CLI exit-code path (internal/cli/status.go, internal/cli/audit*.go, cmd/bunker/main.go) + one new test file. No shared file, no shared package (workflow+bash vs internal/cli), no shared helper. RELEASE-001 is an UNMASKING task (removing continue-on-error) - it deliberately does NOT attempt to make regression green, because making it green requires exactly the harness-binding work that is already owned by the merged INT-CI-025 row; the battery-side binding it adds (bcli target) is the same INT-CI-025 pattern applied to e2e-full-battery.sh. Conflict risk is nil because the two workers never touch the same path.
dispatch_note: Serial merge required: the two branches are merged one at a time, each gated (bash -n / gofmt / go build / go vet / go test) before the next merge. Never a simultaneous merge.
